description: Default capability set for vault-tauri Tauri commands per BRD §5.11 + dialog plugin for ADR-020 fatal-error dialogs + the ADR-SEC-017 log-export save dialog (`dialog:allow-save` is named explicitly rather than relied on through `dialog:default`, so narrowing that default upstream cannot silently remove the export). Permission identifiers follow Tauri 2.5+ auto-generation convention `<crate-name>:allow-<kebab-name>`.
